triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: “He’s ‘insulted’ his father, not only you,” observed Ivan with a forced smile.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: “Why do you run after him? He’ll murder you outright,” Ivan cried wrathfully at his father.

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: “What does Ivan say? Alyosha, my dear, my only son, I’m afraid of Ivan.

triples.subject: Grigory
triples.quote: “I used to wash him in his tub. He’s insulted me,” repeated Grigory.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Beside himself with fury, Dmitri struck out, and hit Grigory with all his might.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: But Dmitri threw up both hands and suddenly clutched the old man by the two tufts of hair that remained on his temples, tugged at them, and flung him with a crash on the floor.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: “Brother, how will all this horror end between father and Dmitri?” exclaimed Alyosha.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: “Shouldn’t you put a wet bandage on your head and go to bed, too?” Alyosha said to him. “We’ll look after him. My brother gave you a terrible blow—on the head.”

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: see for yourself, which she means to choose, him or me. Eh? What? Can you?
